card.name: Carimbo
card.tagline: Afro-Indigenous circle dance and drum music of Para, Amazon.
card.profile: Carimbo is a dance, drum and music genre originating in the 17th century in northern Brazil, centered on Para around Marajo Island and Belem. Named after the curimbo drum (Tupi for 'hollow stick that produces sound'), it blends African syncopation, Indigenous Amazonian circle dancing/maracas and Portuguese elements. The dance is loose and flirtatious: women in long rounded skirts spin while a man tries to retrieve a dropped handkerchief with his mouth. Registered as Intangible Cultural Heritage of Brazil by IPHAN on 9 November 2014 (English Wikipedia; IPHAN).
card.insight: IPHAN registered carimbo as national heritage on 9 November 2014; the 'King of Carimbo' Pinduca is among its most popular performers (English Wikipedia).
